steps.content:
June 25, N.F. 115

5 Hours After the Attack On
The Aurum Secretum Institute

Communication between Fraser and the Aurum Secretum Institute has finally been restored, unleashing a sudden surge of activity across all channels. Most remain oblivious to the institute's shadow operations. They know only fear, the crushing certainty that their quiet lives are now in peril.
And deep within the data sea, a single point of light flickers to life.

- Someone jammed the institute's signal transmission during the attack. The "Cocoon" matrix is damaged, and the Corpus vessel is missing. - What about Hermis? What's the status on-site? Wasn't he overseeing the detonation? - Continue as planned! We've prepared enough vessels beforehand. We can't afford to stop now.

- No, the plan has already failed. - If we can't control the ground zero through the "Cocoon," then even if the Black Ring detonates, it won't be under our control. It's meaningless. - Let's proceed with the contingency plan.
- The true "Corpus" is in position. The seeds of the Black Ring were sown long ago. - The time for harvest has come.
[Black Screen]
Across the barren wasteland, a peculiar procession trudges toward an unknown destination.
Humans, beasts, and shapeless aberrations—the weak and the lost—gather in this endless march, following the sole flame that pierces the darkness.
A gale howls as the sin-stained sun sinks in the west. A creeping shadow swallows its light, leaving only a bleeding ring of crimson upon the horizon.
We are the lost, exiled to this place. We are the forsaken, left with nothing.
And we are the desperate... who twisted our lives just to survive.

In the director's drawer, Saffar uncovered a briefing document—Fraser's Hypercube reserves laid bare. Military. Defense. Commercial. Each category boasted astronomical figures, wealth beyond comprehension.
Yet as DisCity tightened its grip on Hypercube exports, as calamities ravaged the farlands, as resources dwindled and refugees wandered... Fraser could have provided aid. But it chose not to.
They bred hate in us, shattered our bones. When our homeland suffered, we raised empty hands in prayers, swore we'd give Him anything. But He said, "Your 'everything' is dust."
He turned to the next page. This time, it was a calamity status assessment report.
"██ is awakening, and Mania levels throughout the farlands are rising rapidly. The calamities are irreversible; resources will continue to deplete, until the farlands become nothing but a dead zone."

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Aligning with any power is pointless. We're not even worth being pawns. To escape the fate of being crushed... we have to take power for ourselves.
At last, deep within the magic box, he found the final glimmer of light.
Hermis is dead, the research institute destroyed. All channels of information leakage have been severed. The final possibility now rests in our hands.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: If we stand firm, united as one...

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Even we have the power to detonate the Black Ring and defy fate.
[WhiteSands, Solar Eclipse Filter]
The sun drowns in shadow, plunging WhiteSands into gloom.
A chilling silence grips the outskirts of Furor as Hella hurls herself from the sand ship. She dares not imagine what has happened—or what is about to happen.
Her heart hammers against her ribs, a frantic drumbeat urging her forward. She races into Furor.
[Underground Furor, Solar Eclipse Filter]

A black box hovers above the altar. Crimson engravings along its edges flare to life, pulsing in time with the rising chant that echoes through the chamber. Something stirs within—a foreign entity, long dormant, now awakening.

The shell of the inheritance fractures. Dark, viscous corruption bursts forth, spilling like a flood in all directions. The refugees—bent, emaciated, their forms warped by time and suffering—step forward without hesitation, wading into the spreading black tide.
Perhaps this, too, is part of someone's grand design, but it no longer matters. They raise their voices in ragged harmony, singing their gratitude for this mercy, this wretched thread of life.
[Furor, Solar Eclipse Filter]
Hella races ahead, forcing Horo to rush into Furor after her.
The Black Ring is pulsing to life. She can feel the air warping around her. Contamination erupts from beneath her feet, spewing forth corrupted souls.
The spirits of those buried beneath the white sands stir—awakened, ravenous. Corruptors, their hollow eyes fixed on the living, claw at Hella and Horo, desperate to drag them into the grave.
Shadowy tendrils coil around Horo's limbs, binding her. She twists, hewing through the specters with her axe. As they dissolve, ghostly pale-blue crystals materialize in their wake.
—Hypercubes.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella! Damn it... Get back here!!
Ignoring the danger, Hella charges deeper into the contamination's heart. Mania grows thicker by the minute, its whispers slithering into her mind.

steps.speaker: Refugees' Voices
steps.content: Our homeland... destroyed by calamity... leaving us drifting like rootless leaves... But this land... it's too barren... It can't sustain us all...

steps.speaker: Refugees' Voices
steps.content: Survival is too cruel... Death is our only choice...

steps.speaker: Refugees' Voices
steps.content: Stay away... Stop standing in our way...!
Horo lunges, yanking Hella back from an oncoming strike, only for a tendril to snare her instead.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: —Ugh!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...?! No! HORO—!
The corruption swallows Horo whole. Hella reaches for her—their fingers brush, then slip apart—and the darkness consumes them both.
[Black Screen]
In the darkness, Hella hears a chant.
Gentle yet stirring, like a mother's lullaby entwined with a warrior's battle hymn.
The chanting swells, deafening, piercing her eardrums. The world spins, and then—a violent shove from behind.
[Underground Furor, Crimson Filter]
When her eyes open again, she is underground in Furor.
The corruption clinging to her body hasn't faded. Black sludge, oozing from the inheritance, has already swallowed most of the altar, consuming the refugees gathered around it.
Yet the sludge avoids her. Partially corrupted figures press against Hella, their twisted hands shoving her away from the spreading corruption.

steps.speaker: Refugees' Voices
steps.content: Go back, Hella... Don't go any further... You still have somewhere to return to...
Before her, a blue-haired young man staggers forward, each step carrying him closer to his inevitable end. The corruption has already claimed most of his body.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: —Saffar!!!
He halts, then turns his head—just slightly—gazing at the girl in the distance.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: ...Hella? Why are you here?

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: You've already saved Synex. Weren't you supposed to go back to DisCity? This place isn't safe. You should leave.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You idiot, snap out of it! That damn black box is screwing with your head! Or did those Fraser bastards feed you more of their crap?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't let those jerks trick you!! The real Black Ring isn't some miracle thing—it's all lies! I know the truth... it can't even grant your stupid wish!

Hella lunges forward, desperation clawing at her chest, but something snags her, trips her, holds her back again and again. She can only watch, helpless, as the corruption slithers further, consuming Saffar inch by inch.
Yet his voice, when it comes, is eerily calm.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: You're right. Fraser, DisCity—even the Underground you told us about—none of them deserve our trust. They've all used us like pawns. I'm done letting them decide our fate.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: But... I trust you, Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh...?

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: DisCity hoarded their Hypercubes while calamity destroyed our home. Fraser talks about humanism, but all they've done is turn us into lab rats for Aurum Secretum, giving us nothing but ruin.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: But then, you showed up.
[Flashback: Saffar's Encounter with the Undergrounder]

That person told him to help the girl from DisCity—the girl whose homeland had once defied the impossible. Her people had detonated a Black Ring with sheer will, carving their own fate from the jaws of despair.
[Return to normal avg]

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: You brought us stories of Syndicate—proof that even the weak can fight back, that we all have the power to defy fate. You showed us a new path... new possibilities.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: So thank you, Hella... For giving us hope.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No... wait, don't do this...

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Now go. You're the only one we refuse to see harmed.

steps.speaker: Saffar
steps.content: Goodbye, Hella.
The corruption has already crept up to his cheeks when the young man finally smiles. Just as Hella lunges for him, he raises a trembling hand—and pushes her away.
[CG - Sacrifice B]

Then, from the spreading darkness, an arm stretches upward, lifting the black box high. Countless arms follow, surging upward in unison as glistening crystals fracture from their bodies, falling like brittle rain.

steps.speaker: Refugees' Voices
steps.content: Thank you, Hella... for giving us strength, for giving us a choice...

steps.speaker: Refugees' Voices
steps.content: Thank you... Goodbye...

<color=#ca0c1b><size=44>Make a wish...
Power, wealth, anything you can imagine...

Pray to the Ring,
and it shall grant your desires...</color></size>

steps.speaker: Voices of Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>I...</color>
[CG - Sacrifice A]

steps.speaker: Voices of Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>...want a seed.</color>

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No... come back...

Hella reaches out desperately, fingers clawing at the air but finding nothing. Her arms fracture and splinter under the relentless corruption, only to be mended by her regenerative power again and again.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't do this...

Her fingertips dissolve into nothingness, then reform, over and over. She keeps struggling to push forward, yet each effort is met with crushing resistance. She can only watch, helpless, as everything unravels before her.

Amid the chaos, the shackles buried deep within her shudder to life, surging forth in a feeble attempt to shield her. But even they are swiftly overtaken by the corruption. From the other side, a voice cries out to her, but Hella can barely hear it anymore.

steps.speaker: Voices of Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f>One day, it will grow, when the wars are over, when the storms have passed... when no one is left wandering the wastes... and we can finally go home...</color>

steps.speaker: Voices of Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#dg1f1f><size=44>To see how hope rekindles across this land of famine.</color>

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: NOOOOOOOO!!!!!
[Sharp cut to black screen]
[Fade out for several seconds, then transition to Black Ring small CG #1]
In the vast, endless desert, a crimson ring hovers above the jagged peak.
At first, tiny black specks appear in the distance, drifting closer. Drawn by some unseen pull, they surge toward the ring, vanishing into its glow without hesitation.
Then, more come—swarms of darkness, seeping from the horizon. They gather, coalescing into a churning tide, a storm of shadows rushing forth.
The crimson ring trembles as the black storm twists around it, merging and clashing, consuming and consumed—faster, hungrier—
And from the depths of the void, a voice whispers.

<color=#ca0c1b><size=44>So...

What is your wish?</color></size>
<color=#7683a2>I...</color>
[Series of flashback CGs showing various moments from Hella's journey, ultimately leading to the Chief]
<color=#7683a2>I... want...</color>
[ED]
